question: Which of the following represents material in the increasing order of their resistance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Conductors, alloys, insulators**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Conductors**

 
 
• Definition: Materials that allow the easy flow of electric current through them.
 
• Key Characteristics:
 
• High electrical conductivity
 
• Low electrical resistance
 
• Contain free electrons that can move easily within the material.
 
• **Examples:**
 
• Metals (copper, silver, gold, aluminum)
 
• Graphite
 
• Saltwater
 
 
 
• **Alloys**
 
 
• Definition: Materials formed by combining two or more metals (or a metal and a non-metal).
 
• Key Characteristics:
 
• Often possess properties superior to those of the individual constituent metals.
 
• Can be designed to have specific electrical, mechanical, and chemical properties.
 
• **Examples:**
 
• Steel (iron and carbon)
 
• Brass (copper and zinc)
 
• Bronze (copper and tin)
 
• Nichrome (nickel and chromium) - used in heating elements
 
 
 
• **Insulators**
 
 
• Definition: Materials that strongly resist the flow of electric current.
 
• Key Characteristics:
 
• Low electrical conductivity
 
• High electrical resistance
 
• Have tightly bound electrons that cannot move freely.
 
• **Examples:**
 
• Rubber
 
• Plastic
 
• Glass
 
• Wood
 
• Ceramics
